# Huecode

> Huecode is a free, open-source (MIT) color palette generator. It turns a text description or an image into an accessible Tailwind CSS palette, with text colors picked for WCAG contrast, a live UI preview and code export.

## What it does

- Generates a palette from a text prompt (mood, brand, theme) or an uploaded image
- Builds full Tailwind-style shade scales (50-950) for each color
- Picks text colors that reach WCAG contrast: 7:1 for body text (AAA) and 4.5:1 for secondary text (AA), in light and dark
- Previews the palette on real UI components
- Exports Tailwind v4, Tailwind v3, CSS variables or TypeScript tokens
- Optional AI enhancement for written themes can be configured with Anthropic, OpenAI or Gemini (the hosted demo supplies the key; self-hosters add their own)
- Everything except the optional AI enhancement works without an API key
